source: Class list and defaults: OSM Key:railway and Key:gauge (standard gauge 1435 mm; Germany: EBO). Grade limits: EBO 1990 par. 7 / DB Ril 800.0110 (main lines 12.5 permille normal, 40 permille maximum on new lines, steeper on old lines), light rail and tram steeper by design practice [AS]. Piece, smoothing and chain numbers are [AS] engineering choices, tuned on the Rhein-Main census (docs/formats/rail_geom.md).
